name: Bush
style: low-poly, flat colours, stacked faceted leaf mounds (Quaternius 2019)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: The plan's source (a Quaternius static bush on poly.pizza) is behind a Cloudflare challenge; this is Bush_2 from Quaternius's Ultimate Nature Pack on OpenGameArt (License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0), the same zip as the tree, tree-pine and tree-autumn entries, so they read as one set. Of the four bushes in the pack (Bush_1, Bush_2, BushBerries_1, BushBerries_2) it has the roundest footprint (1.2 x 1.2 m; Bush_1 is an elongated 1.1 x 1.4 m) and no berries, so it works as a plain garden shrub or hedge piece. The mesh is a closed solid, so it is not double-sided. Height 1 m: a garden shrub, azalea or a clipped hedge clump along a park path is 0.8-1.2 m, about hip to waist on a 1.6 m person. Colours on noon (no green), as the broadleaf tree: leaves vermilion (accent) shading to iris, so the bush sits under the tree as the same foliage. Its unused Berry material (no faces in Bush_2) maps to leaves. Static: no clips.
